summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose daily share repurchase transaction information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B common stock. The filing confirms ongoing buybacks as part of the program but discloses no specific share counts, prices, timing, or remaining authorization. It is an administrative update required by ASX rules, not a new program announcement. The registrant is executing capital returns to shareholders. What to watch: aggregate repurchase activity in quarterly reports and any updates to program authorization size.
